notes.title: All Achievements Now Working (UPDATE)
notes.content:
TYPOS!!!!!

Hello all,

It was brought to my attention that a couple of achievements weren't working, completely the fault of a couple of typos on my end. I have just updated the game and all achievements should now be working. If you don't have auto-updates enabled you will have to update the game.

If anyone has more trouble with these or anything else, please post on the community page and I will take a look at the issue and begin work to get it resolved as quickly as possible.

Sorry for any inconvenience and happy gaming!

P.S. I am beginning work on new levels which will be added to the game, 1 more to start, then another set of 10.

--Kris
